opus.problem: Naming Pharaoh as the one who set Joseph over 'this land' nearly gives the word away, since Pharaoh is the title of Egypt's king. That makes the clue too easy rather than medium hard.
'From Pharaoh's son' points straight to Egypt, so the clue is close to a giveaway rather than medium hard. The clue also says 'every firstborn' where the verse says 'every firstborn male'.
